component.name: Scotty
component.summary: Universal local file sharing for Linux

description.p: Scotty sends and receives files with the phones, tablets, and PCs around you — no cloud, no account, no cables. It speaks Google Quick Share / Nearby Share, so stock Android phones and Windows machines see your Linux box as a normal device.
Transfers take the fastest available path: the local network when both devices share Wi-Fi, or a self-hosted Wi-Fi hotspot otherwise, with an optional Boost mode for maximum throughput.
